mutations.name: has-refs-scans-normalised-terms
mutations.find: return {k: self.terms[k] for k, v in self._given.items() if has_term_ref(v) and k in self.terms}
mutations.replace: return {k: v for k, v in self.terms.items() if has_term_ref(v)}

mutations.name: normalise-shares-given
mutations.find:
self.spec.schema.normalise_terms(copy.deepcopy(given), allow_refs=self.allow_refs) if self.spec.schema.terms else ({}, None)
        new._given
mutations.replace:
self.spec.schema.normalise_terms(given, allow_refs=self.allow_refs) if self.spec.schema.terms else ({}, None)
        new._given

mutations.name: factory-path-instance-no-type
mutations.find: target = f if hasattr(f, "__qualname__") else type(f)

mutations.name: build-error-lists-all-at-strings
mutations.replace: unresolved references {sorted(k for k, v in self.terms.items() if has_term_ref(v))}
